facts.fact: Phase3 Telecom's release of 8 May 2025 says it, in collaboration with Sonatel, launched a 3,500 km terrestrial fibre route from Lagos, Nigeria to Dakar, Senegal via Benin, Togo and Ghana, interconnecting their backbones, with commercial availability to follow.
